messages:
dana: Quick sync — we need to lock owners and blockers for the v2 endpoint compatibility + deprecation rollout. Current tentative timeline: opt-in canary 2026-04-28, org-wide opt-in 2026-05-15, full deprecate 2026-08-01. Who can own: SDK patch, gateway fallback, docs/migration guide, canary infra?

raj: I can own gateway fallback and routing policy changes. Will need a mapping of which model variants must remain compatible vs allowed to fallback.

michelle: I can take the SDK patch (py + ts). Heads-up: streaming API signature changes — I'll open a draft PR tomorrow. Need at least one runtime reviewer.

chris: I'll review SDK PRs. Also flagging infra load tests — eng-sre needs ~48h notice to schedule a performance job for canary.

michelle: PR will include a compatibility flag: `feature_flag: api_v2_compat=true`. Example snippet in the draft: ```json
{
  "streaming": {"frames": "chunked"},
  "compat_mode": "v2"
}
```

raj: For gateway fallback, I expect a small rollout config: `route_policy: prefer_v2, fallback: v1` and a health check window of 30s. I'll prototype a canary config tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window preflight checks pass for infra (disk, net) but model pool utilization needs <70% to trigger canary.

sara: Docs/help request: I can start the migration guide but need a list of SDK changes and example curl + SDK snippets. If you drop the PR links I can convert into the guide.

dana: Action items: (1) michelle open SDK draft PR by EOD (2) raj post gateway canary config by Tue (3) chris confirm SRE load test window by Mon (4) sara will start docs once PR link posted. Also need a QA owner for compatibility tests — volunteer?

chris: I can own compatibility QA for the SDK -> runtime surface. Will coordinate with qa infra.

michelle: pinging @chris for CR when PR is up. Also tagging @dana for priority — the streaming change touches telemetry events.

raj: note: dependency — the model-variant compatibility matrix is blocked on a small research sign-off (eng-ml). I emailed akshay, waiting on reply. If that delays, fallback policy might need to be wider.

dana: ok, keep me posted. If eng-ml doesn't respond by Fri, we'll broaden fallback policy proactively. Can everyone drop a short status update in this thread when their item is complete? :thumbsup:

michelle: will do. :eyes:

chris: added to my board.

sara: will draft doc skeleton once PR is linked.

raj: gateway config posted: `https://redwood.internal/configs/gateway/canary/v2-fallback-2026-04-28` — prototype in the repo under `infra/canary/v2-fallback.yaml`. Feedback welcome. :shipit:

michelle: got it — I'll reference that in the SDK tests. Thanks.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-04-28 10:00 UTC pending final PR approvals.
